PFIbox promoter-activity screen

Source: vignettes/pfibox-promoter-activity-screen.Rmd
pfibox-promoter-activity-screen.Rmd

This article documents the DStressR reanalysis of the high-density PFIbox promoter-reporter screen of French, Coutts, and Brown (2018), Cell Systems, doi:10.1016/j.cels.2018.07.004. The deposited data contain colony-level time-course measurements for an E. coli promoter-GFP library under antibiotic treatments. The analysis used in the DStressR manuscript treats the established PFIbox promoter activity as the supplied response and then applies the DStressR effect-estimation and inference layers.

Data provenance

The primary deposited dataset is listed as Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/fmv6vv4bsf.1. The public code repository is:

https://github.com/sfrench007/pfibox

The local workflow expects the deposited multi-treatment gfpData.Rdata object under:

data-raw/french_pfibox/source/gfpData.Rdata

The French et al. time-course cluster assignment table can be placed in the same source folder when reproducing the cluster-mapping figure. Large source files and derived tables are intentionally not committed. The provenance note is kept in:

data-raw/french_pfibox/README.md

Response construction

PFIbox estimates promoter activity from fluorescence and a biomass proxy before DStressR is called. In the manuscript workflow, a time window T is chosen and the supplied response is the average promoter activity over that window:

y_i = mean_t_in_T PA_i(t)

The default manuscript run uses T = [2, 18] hours. The DStressR model then uses treatment-level perturbations, where each antibiotic-dose combination is a separate perturbation. Repeated colony positions are included as reporter-wise adjustment terms when supported by the filtered data.

Reproduce the analysis

First audit the downloaded source object:

Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/audit_pfibox_data.R

Then run the promoter-activity subset analysis. The values below reproduce the large subset used for the manuscript figure.

PFIBOX_REPORTER_LIMIT=2000 \
PFIBOX_PERTURBATION_LIMIT=100 \
PFIBOX_T_START_H=2 \
PFIBOX_T_END_H=18 \
PFIBOX_PERTURBATION_TARGET=treatment \
PFIBOX_DESIGN=replicate \
PFIBOX_MODEL_PATH=scalable \
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/run_promoter_activity_analysis.R

This writes the supplied response table, fitted DStressR pair results, and diagnostic summaries under:

analysis/outputs/french_pfibox/promoter_activity_analysis/

The corresponding manuscript figure is generated by:

Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/compute_paper_diagnostics.R
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/map_french_timecourse_clusters_to_destress.R
Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/plot_clustering_and_inference.R

The moderation diagnostic in the supplement compares the same fitted model under moderated and ordinary standard errors:

Rscript analysis/french_pfibox/plot_pfibox_moderation_diagnostic.R

DStressR model call

The script constructs a DStressR assay-like table with one row per retained colony-level response summary. The model call is the same staged API used in the package examples:

fit <- fit_destress(
  assay,
  technical = "replicate",
  testing = "moderated_t",
  adjustment = "by_reporter",
  interaction = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

tab <- results(fit, verbose = TRUE)
hits <- call_hits(
  tab,
  fdr = 0.05,
  effect = "total_effect",
  padj = "total_padj_by_reporter"
)

The fitted object stores the reporter-wise total-effect fits. The results() step extracts total effects, centered specific effects, moderated statistics, and adjusted p-values.
